title: Inkk 0.1.2
release_notes:
What's new in Inkk v0.1.2:
- Performance & Zero-Stutter Writing: Non-blocking background autosave eliminates pen freeze, viewport frustum culling accelerates multi-page notebooks
- Lightweight Previews Drawer: Culls off-screen thumbnails and renders fast vector polylines for instant scrolling
- Whiteboard-native Flowcharting: Shapes and connecting arrows lie directly on the canvas without popup windows
- Interactive Anchor Connection Dots: Hover connection dots appear on block edges; clicking an anchor opens quick-picker to auto-connect with an arrow
- Precision Lasso Selection: Enclosure ratio and centroid filtering to accurately select individual strokes
- Clean launch: Set Windows GUI subsystem to permanently eliminate the background command prompt (cmd) window
